items.details: Choose one complete profile before starting. Profiles A–F keep all three protagonists available through Crossroads; G deliberately ends their stories earlier. These are seven reproducible combinations, not every global ending or flowchart node. For a changed prerequisite, use Chapter Select with SAVE enabled at the earliest affected chapter and play every subsequent chapter continuously. Do not repair an early choice and jump directly to a later chapter: that later checkpoint still contains the old history. Use Continue for the ongoing replay. A new saved story is the reliable fallback when your current history does not match the profile. Xplore stores shared guide coverage, not independent playthrough saves; changing this selector does not change Detroit's save, reset game choices or grant trophies. Verify each outcome in the game before ticking it. Use Experienced for Profile G's deliberately fatal sequences; Casual is a simpler option for the survival profiles. Read each decision's Details before finishing that chapter.

items.details: For every curated profile, find the attic deviant in Partners so The Interrogation is available. Profile G can still follow this investigation; its later decommission is deliberate, not a requirement to miss these early chapters.

After a confession, the scene continues: your response when the officer intervenes is a separate decision with later consequences.

items.details: Keep Hank's relationship friendly for A–F. Talk respectfully, investigate his interests rather than insulting him and prioritize saving him at The Nest instead of pursuing Rupert. Spare the Tracis in The Eden Club. At The Bridge, respond with empathy and do not pursue the hostile-Hank shooting outcome. items.details: For A–F, keep Hank friendly so he can provide a distraction, take the archive key and answer Gavin calmly to avoid an unnecessary lethal confrontation. Enter the evidence room before the timer expires. Use the in-game password choice FUCKINGPASSWORD to unlock the archive; this is the fictional case-terminal answer. Inspect the body of the kitchen deviant preserved in Public Enemy and replace its missing component with the compatible component indicated on another available android. Reactivate it and speak to it once. Then watch Markus's broadcast on the evidence tablet, copy his voice and use that impersonation when questioning the reactivated deviant. Obtain Jericho's location before leaving; a merely completed generic investigation checkbox is not sufficient. Daniel alone cannot answer. If the required body is missing, replay Public Enemy forward with saving. Do not jump directly back here after changing that earlier chapter.

details_i18n.pt: Em A–F, preserve a amizade com Hank para que ele ajude na distração, pegue a chave do arquivo e responda a Gavin com calma para evitar um confronto fatal desnecessário. Entre nas provas antes do fim do tempo. Escolha a senha fictícia do terminal do jogo FUCKINGPASSWORD para desbloquear o arquivo. Examine o corpo do divergente da cozinha preservado em Public Enemy e substitua seu componente ausente por outro compatível indicado em um androide disponível. Reative-o e converse uma vez. Depois veja a gravação de Markus no tablet, copie sua voz e use a imitação ao interrogar o divergente reativado. Obtenha a localização de Jericho antes de sair; apenas marcar uma investigação genérica não basta. Daniel sozinho não responde. Se o corpo necessário não estiver presente, repita Public Enemy em diante com salvamento. Não altere aquele capítulo e pule diretamente para cá.

items.details: The archive reflects what you actually collected earlier. Study the available recordings and objects, then compare compatible components before trying to reactivate a damaged android. One clue may provide a voice, another a key or a response that makes a different clue useful. There is no universal pile of evidence on every save, and an externally supplied location can skip this investigation. If your intended solution needs a missing item, replay with saving from the chapter that supplies it and continue through all intervening chapters.

details_i18n.pt: O arquivo reflete o que você realmente coletou antes. Examine as gravações e objetos disponíveis e compare componentes compatíveis antes de tentar reativar um androide danificado. items.details: For B/C, win Markus's Revolution. Advance using cover and supporting fire, eliminate elevated shooters so the blocked group can move, then use the available cover to throw the grenade. At the earlier two-group barrier, order the nearest group to charge and the farther group to provide covering fire. At the three-group machine gun, order the FRONT-RIGHT group to CHARGE and BOTH other groups, including North on the left, to provide COVERING FIRE. Launch while the machine gun sweeps left; do not send all groups charging or repeatedly waste attacks until success reaches zero. Shoot the drone threatening her group. Complete the final soldier QTEs and fire at the tanks to take the recall center. Inspect the actual prompts and positions rather than relying on fixed controller buttons. Advance using cover and supporting fire, eliminate elevated shooters so the blocked group can move, then use the available cover to throw the grenade. At the earlier two-group barrier, order the nearest group to charge and the farther group to provide covering fire. At the three-group machine gun, order the FRONT-RIGHT group to CHARGE and BOTH other groups, including North on the left, to provide COVERING FIRE. Launch while the machine gun sweeps left; do not send all groups charging or repeatedly waste attacks until success reaches zero. Shoot the drone threatening her group. Complete the final soldier QTEs and fire at the tanks to take the recall center. Inspect the actual prompts and positions rather than relying on fixed controller buttons. details_i18n.pt: Em B/C, vença a Revolução de Markus. Avance com cobertura e apoio de fogo, elimine atiradores elevados para liberar o grupo bloqueado e use a cobertura disponível para lançar a granada. Na barreira anterior com dois grupos, mande o mais próximo atacar e o mais distante oferecer cobertura. Na metralhadora com três grupos, mande o grupo da FRENTE À DIREITA ATACAR e os OUTROS DOIS, incluindo North à esquerda, oferecer COBERTURA. Inicie quando a metralhadora varrer para a esquerda; não mande todos atacar nem desperdice tentativas até a chance chegar a zero. Atire no drone que ameaça o grupo dela. Vença os comandos finais contra soldados e dispare nos tanques para tomar o centro. Confira os comandos e posições reais, sem depender de botões fixos. A morte de Josh pertence a este ramo violento e não é corrigida repetindo seu resgate. C só muda depois dessa vitória, quando Amanda assume Connor.

guides.body: To change a later consequence, start at the earliest prerequisite chapter or checkpoint, choose SAVE and play forward continuously through every intervening chapter for every character. Loading a later chapter directly restores the state previously recorded there; it does not simulate the chapters you skipped with your newly changed decisions. A checkpoint jump in this app only navigates the checklist and cannot load or edit your console save. Before starting cleanup, write down the chapter where the needed choice first becomes possible and the later chapter where its result is checked. Continue normally between those two points. A local alternative can be inspected without saving, but that is not a way to carry a new decision into the rest of the campaign.

guides.body: A route in this app is a curated set of goals, not an additional save slot. Shared completed tasks stay checked when you switch routes; that records guide coverage across your attempts. It does not mean every checked event belongs to the current console timeline. Route-specific goals should be checked only after actually carrying out that version of the event. Use the route's checkpoint link as a reading aid, then load the appropriate point yourself in the game's chapter menu. The game still requires SAVE and uninterrupted forward play for altered prerequisites to reach later scenes. These curated profiles do not enumerate every flowchart combination or every possible ending variation.

guides.body:
This is a separate saved campaign, not Profile A's friendly-Hank history. Start a New Story on Experienced from The Hostage. Keep SAVE enabled and play every intervening chapter in order. Do not collect isolated deaths by jumping between chapter checkpoints.

1. The Hostage: use the self-sacrifice/Emma-rescue outcome in which Connor falls to his death. Keep playing with his replacement.

2. Partners and The Interrogation: find the attic deviant so the interview exists. Probe his memory, stand up, speak coldly when talking again, leave the room and intervene in the ensuing confrontation so the deviant takes a gun and shoots Connor. A confession-only outcome without that death does not count.

3. On the Run: use the squat so the police pursuit happens. Get Kara and Alice across the first highway alive, then have Connor pursue despite Hank's warning and fail Connor's traffic prompts so he is hit. Keep Kara/Alice alive on their remaining crossing if retaining their chapters. Killing them afterward is only an optional shortening method, not another Connor requirement.

4. The Nest: fail the dangerous rooftop chase after the first greenhouse so Connor falls. A successful chase followed by saving Hank is not this death.

5. The Bridge: build HOSTILE Hank through the preceding chapters: be cold/disobedient, spill his drink at Partners and shoot the Tracis in The Eden Club. The killed Tracis are also needed for the later archive method below. At the bridge, follow the cold machine answers and let hostile Hank shoot Connor. If Hank lets him leave, replay from the earlier relationship decisions; one final insult cannot reliably replace them.

6. Public Enemy: find the kitchen deviant. When he removes the regulator, let the shutdown timer expire instead of retrieving it. His escape is acceptable in this separate run because the Tracis supply the later evidence.

7. Meet Kamski and Last Chance, Connor: spare Chloe or otherwise avoid receiving Jericho's location from Kamski. With hostile Hank gone, free the prisoner to distract the station, take the key and make Gavin suspicious by ignoring him or answering ironically. Unlock the archive with the fictional in-game password choice FUCKINGPASSWORD, then use the two Tracis: reactivate the blue-haired one, take her partner's head and use it to trick her into giving Jericho's location. Find the location before the case timer ends, then lose the fight when suspicious Gavin returns. Permanent decommission from missing evidence/time is NOT a replaceable death and ruins the run.

8. Crossroads: remain a machine. If Markus is alive, succeed as Markus in the control-room struggle so he shoots Connor. If Markus already died in a deliberately shortened run, have machine Connor fight the blocking soldier and lose. Do not let Connor kill Markus while expecting Connor's death to register.

Continue normally through Night of the Soul into Battle for Detroit and verify I'LL BE BACK. The later two possible Battle for Detroit deaths are not additional required entries. This guide records the trophy challenge across a continuous saved run, not every possible death animation or an all-survivors ending.

body_i18n.pt:
Esta é uma campanha separada com salvamento, diferente do histórico de amizade com Hank do Perfil A. Comece uma Nova História em Experiente desde The Hostage. Mantenha SALVAR ativado e jogue todos os capítulos intermediários em ordem. Não reúna mortes isoladas pulando entre checkpoints.

1. The Hostage: use o desfecho de sacrifício para salvar Emma em que Connor cai e morre. Continue com a substituição.

2. Partners e The Interrogation: encontre o divergente do sótão para liberar o interrogatório. Sonde sua memória, levante-se, fale com frieza ao conversar novamente, saia da sala e intervenha no confronto seguinte para que o divergente pegue uma arma e atire em Connor. Apenas obter a confissão, sem essa morte, não conta.

3. On the Run: use a casa abandonada para ocorrer a perseguição. Atravesse a primeira rodovia com Kara e Alice vivas; com Connor, insista na perseguição apesar de Hank e falhe nos comandos de trânsito para ser atropelado. Preserve Kara e Alice na travessia restante se quiser manter os capítulos delas. Matá-las depois é somente um encurtamento opcional, não outro requisito de Connor.

4. The Nest: falhe na perseguição perigosa nos telhados depois da primeira estufa para Connor cair. Concluir a perseguição e salvar Hank não é essa morte.

5. The Bridge: construa uma relação HOSTIL com Hank antes: aja com frieza, desobedeça, derrube a bebida em Partners e mate as Tracis em The Eden Club. Elas também fornecem as provas do arquivo mais adiante. Na ponte, siga as respostas frias de máquina e deixe Hank hostil atirar. Se ele permitir a saída, volte às decisões anteriores da relação; um insulto final não as substitui de forma confiável.

6. Public Enemy: encontre o divergente da cozinha. Quando ele retirar o regulador, deixe o prazo de desligamento terminar, sem recuperá-lo. A fuga dele é aceitável nesta campanha separada porque as Tracis fornecem as provas posteriores.

7. Meet Kamski e Last Chance, Connor: poupe Chloe ou evite receber de Kamski a localização de Jericho. Com Hank hostil ausente, solte o preso para distrair a delegacia, pegue a chave e deixe Gavin desconfiado ignorando-o ou respondendo com ironia. Desbloqueie o arquivo com a senha fictícia do jogo FUCKINGPASSWORD e use as duas Tracis: reative a de cabelo azul, pegue a cabeça da companheira e use para enganá-la e obter a localização. Encontre Jericho antes do prazo do caso e depois perca a luta quando Gavin desconfiado voltar. Desativação permanente por falta de provas ou tempo NÃO é uma morte substituível e invalida a sequência.

8. Crossroads: continue máquina. Se Markus estiver vivo, vença com ele a disputa na sala de controle para que atire em Connor. Se Markus já morreu em uma repetição encurtada deliberadamente, faça Connor máquina lutar com o soldado que o bloqueia e perder. Não deixe Connor matar Markus esperando registrar a morte de Connor.

Continue normalmente por Night of the Soul até Battle for Detroit e confira I'LL BE BACK. As duas mortes possíveis posteriores em Battle for Detroit não são requisitos adicionais. O guia registra o desafio do troféu em uma campanha contínua salva, não todas as animações de morte nem um final com todos sobreviventes.

routes.title: Profile A
routes.details:
Peaceful victory; Connor breaks Amanda's control; Kara/Alice/Luther cross without sacrificing Jerry. Confirm Connor, Hank, Kara, Alice, Luther, Jerry, Markus, Simon, North and Josh are alive. This is the selected Survivors profile, not a promise that every unnamed NPC survived.

Choose one complete profile before starting. Profiles A–F keep all three protagonists available through Crossroads; G deliberately ends their stories earlier. These are seven reproducible combinations, not every global ending or flowchart node. For a changed prerequisite, use Chapter Select with SAVE enabled at the earliest affected chapter and play every subsequent chapter continuously. Do not repair an early choice and jump directly to a later chapter: that later checkpoint still contains the old history. Use Continue for the ongoing replay. A new saved story is the reliable fallback when your current history does not match the profile. Xplore stores shared guide coverage, not independent playthrough saves; changing this selector does not change Detroit's save, reset game choices or grant trophies. Verify each outcome in the game before ticking it. Use Experienced for Profile G's deliberately fatal sequences; Casual is a simpler option for the survival profiles. Read each decision's Details before finishing that chapter.

Read the applicable decision steps before each chapter. Profiles B/C use the camp, D the river, A/E/F the bus and border. G omits chapters made inaccessible by earlier story endings. Optional cleanup/collectible tasks describe coverage across replays, not additional quests required in this one save.

Escolha um perfil completo antes de começar. Os perfis A–F mantêm os três protagonistas disponíveis até Crossroads; G encerra suas histórias antes. Leia os Detalhes de cada decisão antes de terminar o capítulo.

Leia as decisões aplicáveis antes de cada capítulo. B/C usam o campo, D o rio, A/E/F ônibus e fronteira. G omite capítulos bloqueados pelo encerramento anterior das histórias.
